trust_decision.summary: Whether the attacker-supplied ?continue= query value may be navigated to after auth; at the pinned commit it is used raw (no same-origin / protocol check) in the login load redirect and the pin-prompt goto; the fix adds Route.continue (must start with '/' and not '//').

landing_point.why: Advisory title names the login page continue redirect; this line reads ?continue and line 13 redirects to it.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /auth/login?continue=... (SvelteKit client load; redirect(307) when already authenticated, and data.continueUrl used by goto after login at web/src/routes/auth/login/+page.svelte:32)

fix_sites.module_kind: page component (neighbouring feature: locked-folder PIN prompt)

fix_sites.entry_point: new shared helper Route.continue (fix.diff:15-21), called by the two sites above

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Maintenance page continue (web/src/routes/+layout.ts:18) is only followed when maintenance mode is off and the URL is under /maintenance, and is normally produced by the server's own maintenance redirect (server/src/maintenance/maintenance-worker.service.ts:153), so it looks like an internal, legacy/admin-only flow rather than a login redirect.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate same-origin deep links with path+query must survive: authenticate() builds continue as url.pathname + url.search and the locked page builds pin-prompt continue the same way; an over-broad fix (fixed allow-list, dropping query strings, rejecting all continue values) breaks returning the user to the page they asked for.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Route.systemMaintenance already takes continue; mirrors maintenanceReturnUrl.
